steps.title: Rebuild the working instructions
steps.explanation: Keep the supplied function and result list. Rebuild the part that fills the list using the example as a guide. Re-run whenever you want to check a change.
steps.task: Fill the result list using this topic's rule.
hints: Each point in this graph is a task. A path from task a to task b means a must happen before b. Put all tasks with no paths coming into them in a queue, in number order. A queue serves the task at its front first. Remove that task, record its number, and remove its outgoing paths. Check its next tasks in number order. Add a task to the back of the queue as soon as it has no paths left coming in. If you cannot record every task, the rules contain a loop: use an empty result list instead.
Revisit the example and copy one instruction at a time, checking what it does.
